commentary.text: 90+7' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+6' It looks like Santiago Mourino (Villarreal) saw red with that tackle. Miguel Sesma won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul. Ath Bilbao earn a free kick.
90+4' Mikel Jauregizar (Ath Bilbao) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.

90+4' Yuri Berchiche (Ath Bilbao) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Ath Bilbao.
90+2' A yellow card for a tackle by Dani Parejo (Villarreal). Miguel Sesma doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
90+1' PENALTY APPEAL after Alberto Moleiro (Villarreal) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Marcelino has decided to substitute Nicolas Pepe and he is replaced by Alfonso Pedraza (Villarreal).
88' Inigo Lekue (Ath Bilbao) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
88' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Villarreal.

84' Alejandro Rego (Ath Bilbao) receives a pass on the edge of the box and attempts a lob as the keeper is off his line, but the effort crashes off the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Villarreal will have a goal kick.
84' Tajon Buchanan (Villarreal) sees a yellow card. He should be more careful because one more challenge like that could result in a red card.
82' The number of offsides is – 7:0.
82' Tajon Buchanan (Villarreal) is adjudged offside.
77' 1 - 0 Goal! Alberto Moleiro (Villarreal) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the left post. It's 1:0.
77' The Villarreal players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
75' Substitution. Maroan Sannadi (Ath Bilbao) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Inaki Williams walks off.
74' Mikel Vesga is substituted due to injury. Jon Aspiazu gives a chance to Alejandro Rego (Ath Bilbao).
72' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Tanitoluwa Oluwaseyi (Villarreal) comes onto the pitch for Georges Mikautadze.
72' Here is a change. Manor Solomon is going off and Marcelino gives the last tactical orders to Alberto Moleiro (Villarreal).
72' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Thomas Partey walks off the pitch to be replaced by Dani Parejo (Villarreal).
72' Renato Veiga (Villarreal) fouls an opponent during an attacking move. Ath Bilbao win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
72' The linesman makes the right call and Ath Bilbao will have a corner.
71' Ath Bilbao have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
70' 11:15 – the total goal attempt statistics.
67' Jon Aspiazu has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jesus Areso (Ath Bilbao) replacing Gorka Guruzeta.
67' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Mikel Vesga (Ath Bilbao) replaces Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta.
64' Villarreal force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
64' Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Villarreal.
64' A cross into the box from Manor Solomon (Villarreal) is cleared.

62' That was close by Pape Gueye (Villarreal)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes by a whisker over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Ath Bilbao will have a goal kick.
61' Sergi Cardona (Villarreal) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.

58' What a chance that is! Nicolas Pepe sends a great ball towards Rafa Marin (Villarreal), whose shot from the edge of the box flies a whisker wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Ath Bilbao.
57' A substitution has been made. Unai Gomez goes off and Robert Navarro (Ath Bilbao) comes on.
56' Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) misses an absolute sitter after connecting with a cross inside the penalty box. The ball goes out of play and Ath Bilbao will have a goal kick.
56' The Villarreal players are exchanging some short passes.
53' Sergi Cardona (Villarreal) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
51' Inigo Lekue (Ath Bilbao) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
48' Sergi Cardona (Villarreal) tries to find Manor Solomon, but he puts too much power on the pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Ath Bilbao.
46' Half-time substitution. Marcelino decided to make a change. Ilias Akhomach is replaced by Tajon Buchanan (Villarreal).
46' The whistle blows and Miguel Sesma starts the second half.
45+1' The match has reached half-time.
44' Manor Solomon (Villarreal) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
43' Villarreal enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
41' Inigo Lekue (Ath Bilbao) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked.
40' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta (Ath Bilbao).

39' Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) climbs high to connect with a cross near the penalty spot but plants a header well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Villarreal will have a goal kick.
38' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
37' Pape Gueye (Villarreal) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Ath Bilbao.
36' Corner kicks – 4:2.
33' A lofted cross from Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
31' The shots on goal statistics – 3:4.
29' Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
28' Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. Villarreal force their opponents to concede a corner.
27' Ath Bilbao earn a corner.

27' Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Luiz Junior makes a stunning save to stop the effort from flying into the roof of the net. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Ath Bilbao will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
24' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Ath Bilbao.
24' Corner kick. Manor Solomon (Villarreal) is ready to send the ball into the box.
21' Ath Bilbao have been awarded a corner kick.
21' Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta (Ath Bilbao) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man. The linesman points to the corner flag, Ath Bilbao are going to take it.
20' Pape Gueye (Villarreal) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Miguel Sesma blows for a foul. Ath Bilbao will take a free kick.

18' Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a low strike towards the middle of the goal. Unai Simon guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save.

18' Luiz Junior makes a sensational save to thwart a great chance. A rebound falls to Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) on the edge of the box and he strikes goalwards, but the ball ends up in the keeper's gloves instead of the bottom left corner.
17' Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety.
14' Georges Mikautadze (Villarreal) tries to find Manor Solomon, but he puts too much power on the pass.
14' Great teamplay by Villarreal as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.

13' Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Miguel Sesma with no other option than to blow for a foul. That's a free kick to Villarreal.
12' This shall not pass! Unai Gomez (Ath Bilbao) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender.
11' The flag is raised and Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) is offside again, not for the first time today.
9' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) heads on.
9' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Mikel Jauregizar (Ath Bilbao). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate.
9' Ath Bilbao seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
7' Aymeric Laporte (Ath Bilbao) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
6' Aymeric Laporte (Ath Bilbao) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
5' Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) fires a rebound from mid-range onto the left post! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Ath Bilbao.
5' Manor Solomon (Villarreal) is about to take a corner kick.
5' The corner kick from Manor Solomon (Villarreal) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders. Good work from Villarreal as they win a corner.
4' Miguel Sesma blows his whistle as Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack. Villarreal have a free kick.

3' What an opportunity that was! The ball rebounded out to Santiago Mourino (Villarreal), whose shot from the edge of the box goes a whisker wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Ath Bilbao will have a goal kick.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out at last! Villarreal will take the kick-off.
Miguel Sesma will supervise the game today.
